title: obc-pack config
description: Configuration for the obc-pack map packer (.osm.pbf -> .obcm). Feature styling is an ordered map: style IDs are assigned 1-based in document order (at most 254 styles), and a way is styled by the first (tag_key, value) match in that order. The packer ignores unknown keys at the root and inside style objects, so tooling metadata (`_meta`, `disabled`) can ride along and any exported file doubles as a CLI config.

features.description: OSM tag_key -> value -> style. Document order is load-bearing: it assigns style IDs and first-match wins. Within a tag_key, the value "*" is a catch-all: an exact value match wins, otherwise a "*" entry styles every other value that key carries (e.g. building -> "*" paints all buildings without listing each OSM type).

lods.description: LOD pyramid, coarsest tier first. Absent or empty means a single coarsest layer.

marker.description: User-position marker; the shape is fixed in firmware, only the color is configurable.

chunk_size.description: Quadtree chunk payload target in bytes. The maximum is the reader's per-feature vertex cap; the minimum guards against chunks so small that features are dropped wholesale. Values outside the range are rejected at pack time. Governs the geometry sections (LODs) only; the nav graph's chunks are pinned to 512 bytes.

routing.description: Nav-graph routing config (OBCM v9 §8): the island-pruning threshold plus the bike profiles baked into the map's profile table. Absent means the four shipped profiles (Road / Gravel / MTB / Touring).

min_component_edges.description: Drop each disconnected graph component with fewer than this many edges (the largest is always kept), so a rider can't snap onto an unroutable islet.

profiles.description: 1..=8 bike profiles selectable on the device by index. Each weights nav edges by highway + surface class; every multiplier is >= 1.0 (or the string "forbidden") so the great-circle A* heuristic stays admissible.

color.description: RGB565 as a `0x`-prefixed hex string (1-4 digits) or an integer 0..=65535. Pick values on the panel's RGB222 grid (4 levels per channel) so the editor and the glass agree.

max_mpp.description: Meters-per-pixel upper bound for this tier; null means the coarsest (overview) tier.

simplify.description: Topology-preserving simplify tolerance in meters; 0 means no simplification.

min_area_px.description: Drop area features (polygons) whose projected area is below this many square pixels at the tier's finest on-screen scale; 0 means no culling. Lines are never culled. Ignored on the finest tier (no coarser fallback).

style.description: One feature style. `id` is never configured - it is assigned from document order.

z_index.description: Painter's order; lower is drawn first.

priority.description: Chunk-overflow drop order: 1 is kept longest, 4 dropped first.

min_lod.description: Index of the coarsest LOD tier that includes this feature; it appears in every tier >= min_lod (0 = visible from the overview tier).

line_style.description: Line stroke style (OBCM v10, epic #556): "solid" (a flat stroke, the default) or "dashed". Ignored for polygons.

color2.description: Optional secondary color (RGB565), specified exactly like `color`. Its role depends on line_style and geometry (OBCM v10, epic #556): a casing under a solid line, the base stripe of a dashed railway, or a polygon ring outline. Absent means no secondary color.

multiplier.description: One routing edge-weight multiplier: a number >= 1.0 (quantized to 1/16 fixed-point on the wire, so 1.0 = neutral, capped ~16x) or the string "forbidden" (the class is not routable). Values below 1.0 are rejected at pack time - the great-circle A* heuristic must stay admissible.

profile.description: One bike profile: a display name plus per-class edge-weight multipliers. Classes not listed in `highway`/`surface` use `default`.

name.description: Display name shown on the device (UTF-8, at most 12 bytes on the wire).

default.description: Multiplier applied to any highway/surface class not listed below.

highway.description: Per-highway-class multipliers, keyed by canonical class name.

surface.description: Per-surface-class multipliers, keyed by canonical class name.
